units.name: Division of Management Sciences and Marketing
units.evidence: The official business-school page names the Management Sciences and Marketing division and describes operations and supply-chain research and doctoral-study opportunities. The university Business and Management PhD page directly links this division and its operations and supply-chain doctoral research theme.

decisions.reason: The source assertion is a faculty-reported PhD institution, not a department. The named division is verified separately from official university pages.

sources.note: Official Business and Management PhD programme page opened in the browser. Its programme description explicitly links the Division of Management Sciences and Marketing and lists operations and supply chain management among doctoral research themes.

Official Alliance Manchester Business School division page opened in the browser. Exact Management Sciences and Marketing division name, operations and supply-chain remit, doctoral study opportunities and University of Manchester identity established.

limitations: Wider university business and engineering unit inventories remain incomplete.
The five individual OM List degree claims remain discovery evidence only; this institutional review does not verify them.

branches.conclusion: One current Business and Management PhD pathway in the explicitly named Management Sciences and Marketing division is verified; operations and supply-chain management is a stated doctoral research theme. Wider doctoral coverage remains incomplete.
No engineering doctoral inventory reviewed in this proposal; no absence or extra route inferred.
